cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：以色列的
cards.example_en: An Israeli coach visited our basketball team last month.
cards.example_zh: 上个月一位以色列教练来看望了我们篮球队。

cards.example_en: I squeezed a lemon over the fish Mum grilled for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我在妈妈午饭烤的鱼上挤了一个柠檬。

cards.example_en: Paint left a mess on the floor of the art room.
cards.example_zh: 颜料把美术教室的地板弄得一片混乱。

cards.example_en: Her method is to read the questions before the passage.
cards.example_zh: 她的方法是先读题目，再读文章。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：麦克风
cards.example_en: Tap the microphone if the back row cannot hear you.
cards.example_zh: 如果后排听不清，就敲一下麦克风。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：军事的
cards.example_en: My uncle wore his military uniform at the parade.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔在游行时穿着军装。

cards.example_en: Stir the mix until the flour disappears into the milk.
cards.example_zh: 把混合料搅拌到面粉完全融进牛奶里。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：模型；模特
cards.example_en: The clay model of the volcano cracked while it was drying.
cards.example_zh: 火山的黏土模型在晾干时裂开了。

cards.example_en: My cousin in Norway sent a photo of deep winter snow.
cards.example_zh: 我在挪威的表哥寄来一张隆冬大雪的照片。

cards.example_en: Is it ok if I borrow your ruler for maths?
cards.example_zh: 数学课上我借一下你的尺子，可以吗？

cards.example_en: You ought to bring your book tomorrow.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：飞行员
cards.example_en: The pilot checked the weather before take-off.
cards.example_zh: 飞行员在起飞前查看了天气。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：朴素的
cards.example_en: She wore a plain dress to the family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一条朴素的裙子去参加家庭晚餐。

cards.example_en: We missed the bus home because the plane was late.
cards.example_zh: 因为飞机晚点，我们没赶上回家的公交。

cards.example_en: Hikers rely on a paper map when phones lose signal.
cards.example_zh: 手机没有信号时，徒步的人依靠纸质地图。
